entities.summary: The Dr. Moises Frumencio da Costa Gomez University of Curaçao, formerly University of The Netherlands Antilles, is the state university of Curaçao. It is a public university, graduating approximately three hundred students per year. The quality and level of the program are similar to those in the Netherlands. All programs provided at the university are accredited by The Nederlands-Vlaamse Accreditatieorganisatie (NVAO).
